subject: 🎓 Gown Order Receipt — $ceremony_name (£$cost)
body:
Dear $student_name,

Thank you for your graduation gown order. This email is your receipt and confirms the items you have ordered for the ceremony.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
ORDER DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Ceremony:        $ceremony_name
Ceremony Date:   $ceremony_date
Gown size:       $gown_size
Hat size:        $hat_size
Hood subject:    $hood_subject

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PAYMENT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Amount paid:     £$cost
Payment method:  $payment_method_display
Reference:       $payment_reference
Date:            $payment_date
$balance_line

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT NOW

  • Your gown will be available for collection during your robing window on the day.
  • Bring this receipt (or your student ID) to collect your gown.
  • Gowns must be returned after the ceremony to avoid a late-return charge.

If any of the details above are wrong, please contact the Graduation Office as soon as possible.

With warmest congratulations,
The Graduation Office
